'''Nichevo group''' was a group of 3 [[Container transport]]s that served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was present at the [[attack on the missile boat convoy]].
